name: Wayuu Women's Force Observatory: Indigenous Peoples' Rights
content: Problems and Purpose The Wayuu Women's Force Observatory: Indigenous Peoples' Rights is an initiative that emerged in 2014 from the Wayuu Women's Force movement, with the support of the Basque organization IPES ELKARTEA and the European Union. The Observatory seeks to generate research on the different realities of the region, to monitor conflicts between communities and mining companies, as well as to make visible the violation of indigenous peoples' rights and human rights. Background History and Context The launch of the Observatory took place in the Wayuu Zahino Reservation in southern Guajira - Barrancas Municipality, before traditional Wayuu authorities, NGOs, and the Association of Authorities, Wayuu Indigenous Councils of Southern Guajira AACIWASUG. The Wayuu leaders at the head of the Observatory received death threats from criminal organizations in 2018 for their work in the territory.
